_doc: Each box was read by eye at 2-10x PIL crops with 1 m ticks computed from box_en (2022 left, 2020 right). A square counts only if a stroke leaves its foot in both years, or one clear stroke with a head where the other year is shadowed. The sun bearing was checked per box: 2020 is NW in most boxes and N or NE in m2400, j4982 and j6033. Edge and shadow cases are counted correct and named under unjudgeable.

boxes.box: j108 East Colfax Avenue / North Lincoln Street
boxes.unjudgeable: l0019 sits on the north edge (shadow leaves the box), counted correct. l0018: the lamp's foot is at about (-90.4,21.4) by the railing; the square is on mulch 2.4 m SE. g0024: a tall pole with pedestrian heads on it and only a luminaire arm, no arm over the roadway. l0022: 2020 shows an 8 m stroke ending in a cobra head from (-116,14.5): a lamp, not an unknown post.

boxes.box: j929 12th Street / Glenarm Place / West Colfax Avenue
boxes.unjudgeable: none; NE lamp near (-866,22) has its foot at/outside the east edge

boxes.box: j1905 15th Street / Stout Street
boxes.unjudgeable: l0215 lies in 2022 tower shadow and shows only a dot in 2020: kept as correct without proof. g0212 is a decorative scroll lamp; its heads are not clearly visible, class left as given.

boxes.box: j2328 15th Street / Lawrence Street
boxes.unjudgeable: the whole 2022 half is in building shadow; judged on 2020 alone. The east corner (~-1087,838) and the west corner (~-1119,822) are in deep shadow both years: recall there unknown.

boxes.box: j2835 14th Street / Blake Street
boxes.unjudgeable: l0328: only a <1 m dark mark at the curb ramp both years (button stub or bollard), no post stroke. l0325 is weak (2022 thin stroke; 2020 coincides with a wall-end shadow), kept. l0334 on the west edge, kept. l0324 is a short globe lamp, real.

boxes.box: j3368 Lawrence Street / North Speer Boulevard

missed.note: on the bike-path edge: 2022 a north stroke ending in a plate, 2020 a NW stroke from the same foot

boxes.unjudgeable: g0405 shows one luminaire arm reaching over the sidewalk and no heads in either year. A short object at about (-1347.3,565) next to g0410 shows the same stroke in both years, so it is not a clear post; ignored.

boxes.box: j3750 Champa Street / North Kalamath Street / North Speer Boulevard
boxes.unjudgeable: l0438 is a sign post (plate shadow); post_unknown is unspecific, not wrong

boxes.box: j4541 North Kalamath Street / North Speer Boulevard / Stout Street
boxes.unjudgeable: l0505 carries boxy signal heads on its shadow in both years at the kerb corner, so it is not a utility pole. g0507 (moderate confidence): an arm with a head reaches about 7.5 m SE to (-1240,132.5) over the crosswalk, in the same place both years. l0508's shadow falls into building shadow both years; counted correct without proof.

boxes.box: j4982 Galapago Street / West 14th Avenue

missed.note: tall pole whose foot is under tree canopy; the 2022 north shadow (about 11 m) ends in a head at -181.8; moderate confidence

boxes.unjudgeable: l0541: the luminaire arm reaches west in the same place both years, and boxy heads sit on its shadow both years. The SE corner was rebuilt between 2020 and 2022 (2020 posts at (-989.3,-185.3) and (-986,-184.8) are gone) and lies in building shadow, so it is not judged. l0539 is a pay-station solar-panel pole (post_unknown accepted). l0536 is on the west edge.

boxes.box: j6033 East 14th Avenue / Sherman Street
boxes.unjudgeable: l0672 is a ground-level white globe (uplight or bollard light) with no post stroke in either year. l0678 and g0677's arm show relief displacement, the same in both years; both are real.
